Implement the following requested change in the repository.

astroid depends on 'crypt', which is removed in Python 3.13
Still present in git and 3.0.1.
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2246054

According to https://docs.python.org/3.13/whatsnew/3.13.html:

PEP 594: Remove the crypt module and its private _crypt extension, deprecated in Python 3.11.
The hashlib module is a potential replacement for certain use cases.
Otherwise, the following PyPI projects can be used:
- bcrypt: Modern password hashing for your software and your servers.
- passlib: Comprehensive password hashing framework supporting over 30 schemes.
- argon2-cffi: The secure Argon2 password hashing algorithm.
- legacycrypt: Wrapper to the POSIX crypt library call and associated functionality.
(Contributed by Victor Stinner in gh-104773.)

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and submit the resulting local patch: astroid/_backport_stdlib_names.py, astroid/brain/brain_crypt.py, astroid/const.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.

-    # Skip registration if we're on Python 3.13+ where crypt is removed
-    if not PY313_PLUS:
+    if PY313_PLUS:
+        # In Python 3.13+, crypt module is removed so we should raise an error
+        def transform_error(node: nodes.Module) -> None:
+            raise ImportError(
+                "The crypt module has been removed in Python 3.13. "
+                "Use hashlib or one of these PyPI packages instead: "
+                "bcrypt, passlib, argon2-cffi, legacycrypt"
+            )
+        manager.register_transform(nodes.Import, transform_error,
+                                 lambda n: any(name[0] == "crypt" for name in n.names))
+    else:
         register_module_extender(manager, "crypt", _re_transform)
